title: Hue Amazing Marathon 2026 Review: Vietnam's Imperial-City 42K
seo_title: Hue Amazing Marathon 2026 Review | Vietnam Imperial City Race
meta_description: The Hue Amazing Marathon 2026: August 29-30 weekend in Hue, Vietnam. Full marathon from BOLT EVENT's Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series — registration open.
dek: Set for the 29-30 August 2026 weekend in Hue — Vietnam's ancient imperial capital — this BOLT EVENT production is part of the Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series. Four distances with registration open.
verdict: The Hue Amazing Marathon brings a full marathon to Vietnam's most culturally significant city — the former imperial capital with its UNESCO-listed Citadel, the Perfume River, and the royal tombs of the Nguyen Dynasty. Produced by BOLT EVENT as part of the Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series, it offers a race-weekend format across two days. August in Hue is the tail of the summer season — warm but the city's tree-lined boulevards provide some shade. For runners wanting a Vietnamese marathon with genuine cultural depth beyond the big-city races, this is a standout.

sections.heading: Hue: Vietnam's Imperial Capital
paragraphs: Hue is Vietnam's former imperial capital — a UNESCO World Heritage site with the Citadel, the Perfume River, and the royal tombs scattered along its banks. [1] A marathon here offers cultural immersion that no other Vietnamese race can match. BOLT EVENT's Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series provides professional race production.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A full marathon in Vietnam's imperial capital with open registration. 29-30 August 2026 weekend in Hue. [1]

faqs.question: When is the Hue Amazing Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Race weekend 29-30 August 2026 in Hue, Vietnam. Registration open. It offers 42.2K, 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. BOLT EVENT ('Amazing Marathon Vietnam Series') organises the event. It's held at Huế (race weekend 29-30 Aug). [1]
